title: ConfirmationChallengeV2
description: Daemon-issued confirmation challenge, protocol version 2. Short-lived and daemon-memory-only; the operation result is durable in canonical event history. The challenge is authorization scratch, never Product state. The binding is a STRICT SUPERSET of the shipped v1 ChallengeBinding (crates/bicameral-api/src/confirmation_challenge.rs:123): workspace, session_id, packet_id, requested_outcome, and request_id are retained because they carry shipped typed fail-closed outcomes. Those fields are authorization scope, which is a separate concern from Product routing identity. TTL is 300 seconds, matching the shipped CONFIRMATION_CHALLENGE_TTL_SECONDS. See docs/specs/state-machine-resolver-v1-runtime-architecture.md section 7 and amendment 001.

protocol_version.description: A v1 challenge presented for an smr_claim_set_v1 candidate, or a v2 challenge presented for a decision_v1 candidate, fails closed with unsupported_contract_version.

challenge_id.description: Cryptographically random. Single-use, actor-bound, and invalid after daemon restart.

operation_id.description: Caller-supplied durable idempotency identity, unique per (product_id, actor_id). Caller supply is required: a daemon-minted identifier the caller never observed could not be retried after a lost response, which would defeat restart-safe idempotency.

request_id.description: Retained from v1. Per-request audit correlation from the existing ToolRequest contract. Distinct from operation_id and never aliased to it.

workspace.description: Retained from v1. Authorization scope, not Product routing identity. A mismatch fails closed as WorkspaceMismatch.

session_id.description: Retained from v1. Agent session the request originated from. A mismatch fails closed as Unauthorized.

packet_id.description: Retained from v1. RecallPacket the candidate was surfaced in. A mismatch fails closed as PacketMismatch.

requested_outcome.description: Retained from the shipped v1 ChallengeBinding. A mismatch fails closed as OutcomeMismatch. promote_smr_claim_set permits every value except dismissed_as_noise; reject_smr_claim_set requires dismissed_as_noise. Amendment 001 makes this action pairing normative and validator-enforced.

proposal_identity.description: Any mismatch invalidates the challenge, appends nothing, and returns a typed proposal_identity_mismatch naming the mismatched field. The daemon must not silently rehash, rewrite the proposal, substitute a newer candidate generation, or retry against a new snapshot.

expires_at.description: issued_at plus exactly 300 seconds. The owner bundle proposed 600; that doubles the window in which a stale or confused-deputy confirmation can be replayed against a human gesture and diverges from the constant already enforced and tested in the runtime.

display_summary.description: Daemon-authored human-readable exact effect. MCP renders this verbatim and never authors it. Excluded from confirmation_binding_digest and from every semantic digest; bound indirectly through display_summary_digest so a cosmetic wording change cannot alter Claim identity.

display_summary_digest.description: Digest of display_summary. Included in confirmation_binding_digest so the human's confirmation provably covers the exact text they inspected.

confirmation_binding_digest.description: Domain-separated digest using artifact name confirmation-binding over every field in this object except display_summary and confirmation_binding_digest itself. requested_outcome is included.
